messages:
maria_ops: Anybody seeing 403s from the ci-runner proxy after the proxy pod rotation an hour ago? Canary deploys started failing with 'impersonation denied: service account not found' around 11:42. Affected job: nightly/integration-runner.

chao_infra: Which service account is the runner using? pw-proxy-runner? Can you paste the exact proxy error line and the deploy id?

maria_ops: Error snippet:
```text
2026-03-16T11:42:13Z ERROR impersonation failed: 403 Forbidden - token exchange denied for 'projects/-/serviceAccounts/pw-proxy@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com'
```
Deploy id: ci-runner-canary #537.

alex_w: Fwiw we saw something like this last quarter. Usually a cache/refresh mismatch: proxy caches impersonated tokens but the token issuer TTL + jitter caused the proxy to hold expired creds. Check REFRESH_WINDOW / REFRESH_JITTER and issuer TTL.

chao_infra: Quick repro commands you can run from the proxy pod: 
```bash
kubectl exec -it deploy/ci-runner-proxy -c proxy -- sh -c "curl -sS -H 'Metadata-Flavor: Google' http://metadata/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token"
kubectl logs -f deploy/ci-runner-proxy -c proxy | grep -i token
```
Those show whether metadata/issuer is healthy and what the proxy log says.

maria_ops: Ran the metadata curl — metadata returns 200 and a token. Proxy logs show repeated messages after rotation: 'cached token expired, next refresh in 90s' and then immediate 403s for impersonation requests. Config has REFRESH_WINDOW=60s REFRESH_JITTER=120s.

alex_w: That jitter is probably the culprit — jitter longer than TTL means some requests hit an expired cache. Short-term fix: restart the proxy pod to force a fresh fetch (you already did?), then set REFRESH_JITTER <= 30s or align TTL. Longer-term: make refresh idempotent and have healthcheck fail if cached token expiry < threshold.

maria_ops: Restarted the pod, canaries green again. Will open an infra PR to reduce jitter and add a readiness probe that checks token freshness.

deploy-bot: deploy ci-runner-canary #537 failed -> status=403, step=impersonate-create-token, logs=/var/log/ci-runner/537.log :warning:

support-bot: Created support ticket SUP-2026-428 and attached the proxy logs + deploy id. Assigned to #eng-infra. :ticket:

maria_ops: Thanks — linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/812. If anyone sees recurrence after the config change, ping me and I'll rollback.

chao_infra: :thumbsup: I'll add an alert for "proxy cached expired token" and update the runbook with the quick restart workaround and the REFRESH_* knobs to check.
